received_works.body:
いをちゃんの描く聖十郎が見たいです。
可哀想なのでもそうじゃないのでも
なんでも食べたいです。
よろしくお願いします！！！！

I'm an anonymous pillar, familiar with how many times I've been played by skeebs.
I feel like I should no longer write anything here, so please write our child based on your references. Please write about my child based on the reference material!
I hope this request reaches Shan (I wish).

https://x.com/trtrtr_ma/status/1844037453541417213?s=46&t=ZIsZeKgMTtyb651n-m5YDg

Sorry for the great delay, Mr. Yiri, but I would like to commission a new painting for 🙇‍♀️💦.

I had a lot of trouble deciding, but this time I would like you to draw a character of my creation. I don't care if it's a small or large child, either way. I like both of your designs so much that I couldn't choose one. Please choose the one you like best. We don't even have a pose for you to choose. You can draw it in any way you like.

I have put some of the character settings and some of my drawings below for your reference.
I look forward to seeing your work.

Setting
The head (hair style) is jellyfish hair, and the angel's ringlets are water jellyfish.
Cute little girl
Clothes are silk, cuffs wide, one piece of cloth.
Hands are 🦀.
Her wings are a flying fish.
She has no facial expression. Does not show negative emotions.

Here are the haircut material and the full body material. The hair style is different, but should match the hair material. Hair color is white and eye color is blue.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-7VxPjiDMAoxBn5d0YgDqZa3Hf-yACd7

I would like you to draw a picture for the header! I want a picture of a black cat staring at me. I'll leave the rest of the composition up to you! (I want the eyes to not cover the black part on top of the iphone screen...)

Hi 先生. I love your art style and would like for you to draw my original characters Akimitsu and Hatsuki in your style. Akimitsu is a handsome, tall, charming, delinquent. He is 182 cm. He is seen as a helpful and cool senpai, but in reality, is very cunning and mischievous. Hatsuki is a cheerful, cute, and naive teenager. He is 165 cm. Some important facial details are that Hatsuki has two moles on the left and right sides of his face and the bottom part of his right jaw. He is also wearing tiny black earrings. For the pose, can you please have Akimitsu messing with Hatsuki's hair with a teasing smile, while Hatsuki has a pout on his lips and looks mildly annoyed and is reaching his hands up to try and stop Akimitsu? Thank you for your time and consideration.

Akimitsu: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lw9QknOgbgxUJKgiD-f5-qaSWLZXdbkc?usp=sharing
Hatsuki: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zMAy6yO9srBXa-yClUOhWUmrAcH109Rn?usp=sharing

Thank you for your understanding.
This is my first time to send a request.

I always enjoy seeing your wonderful illustrations on X. I love your illustrations so much that I contacted you to ask you to draw my original character!
I love your illustrations so much that I contacted you to ask you to draw my original characters.
What I would like to request are the two boys from the URL below.

They are brothers game players.
You can skip the details of the costumes.

Usage
Video thumbnails and headers
Enjoy looking at them
etc.
(We do not use them for money-consuming purposes such as selling goods)

*Size, etc.*
I am happy to see a beautiful picture if the size is 1920px or larger!
I will be happy to see a beautiful picture if the size is 1920px or more!
I like any of your drawings, but I especially like high ones!
I like any of your drawings, but I would appreciate it if you could draw it in a way that is easy for me to draw.
I would be happy if you could draw it as a PSD file with separate layers for the background and the character.

If possible*, I would appreciate it if you could draw it as a PSD file with the background and the character in separate layers.
I would appreciate it if you could trim the left, right and head of the characters without cutting them off.
I would appreciate it if you could separate the layers so that I can use them one by one.
I like coloring pictures, so I would appreciate it if you could give me line drawings of the characters.


For more details, please refer to the following URL.

▼Character
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ErC1d9S9PWOgDm4j_ojzGq_ncezUlVGc?usp=drive_link


Thank you for your consideration.

何卒よろしくお願いいたします！
